CHAPTER.VERS: And as he went forth out of the temple, one of his disciples says to him, Teacher, look, what manner of stones and what manner of buildings!
And Jesus said to him, Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.
And as he sat on the mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
Tell us, when will these things be? And what [will be] the sign when these things are all about to be accomplished?
Many will come in my name, saying, I am [he]; and will lead many astray.
For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there will be earthquakes in diverse places; there will be famines: these things are the beginning of travail.
And the good news must first be preached to all the nations.
And brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child; and children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house:
and let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
But woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse in those days!
For those days will be tribulation, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.
And except Yahweh had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the elect's sake, whom he chose, he shortened the days.
for there will arise false Christs and false prophets, and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, the elect.
But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give her light,
and the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
And then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
And then he will send forth the angels, and will gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
Heaven and earth will pass away: but my words will definitely not pass away.
But of that day or that hour knows no one, not even the angels in heaven nor even the Son, but the Father.
[It is] as [when] a man, sojourning in another country, having left his house, and given authority to his slaves, to each one his work, commanded also the porter to watch.
